name: fund-review
description: End-to-end quote generation and financial-review pre-audit for government IT procurement. Three orthogonal layers: a region-neutral BOM (function-point single source of truth with NESMA quality gates), per-region standard packs where every parameter carries a page-level citation, and per-deal delivery plans covering on-prem/SaaS mixes with operating-period costs and TCO. Generates procurement lists, function-point worksheets, compilation notes and a self-audit report; syncs to Feishu for human-in-the-loop review.
